task.title: To log in to X-Author Contracts

step.cmd: Launch Microsoft Word. Open a new document or the document you want to work with.
Launch the X-Author add-in as described in Installing X-Author Contracts.
After the X-Author add-in pane loads, hover over the icon on the left-hand side to display the login menu.
Depending on the org you want to connect to, select Sign-In to Production or Sign-In to Sandbox.
If it is the first time you are logging into the org, you will be prompted to allow X-Author to access Salesforce. Click Allow to proceed.
Enter your Salesforce credentials to log in.

result.p: After successful login, the X-Author pane refreshes and displays additional tabs.
